question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Relevent"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Relevant"**. (प्रासंगिक)

 
 
• **Example:** The evidence is **relevant **to the case.
 
 
 
• **"Relevant"** means closely connected or appropriate to what is being done or considered. (प्रासंगिक)
 
 
• **Example:** Please provide **relevant **details in your report.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Embarrass **(शर्मिंदा): It means to cause someone to feel awkward, self-conscious, or ashamed.

 
 
• **Example:** She didn't want to embarrass him by correcting his mistake in public.
 
 
 
• **Connoisseur **(पारखी): An expert judge in matters of taste.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a connoisseur of fine wines.
 
 
 
• **Bureaucracy** (नौकरशाही): A system of government in which most of the important decisions are made by state officials rather than by elected representatives.
 
 
• **Example:** The bureaucracy is often blamed for inefficiency and delays in the public sector.
